source_quotes: host passes {data,context} to pipelines; mains must unwrap data
overlap_check: Built-in method_40 (persisted shape must match the loader's parse shape) is the storage analogue; this is the call shape. New and small.

payload.name: Host-Called Pipelines Accept the Envelope and Flat Input
payload.description: The host hands every pipeline an input wrapped as data plus context. A pipeline main unwraps it when both parts are present and still accepts flat input, so a parse error is never an envelope in disguise.

principles.name: Read what the host sends
principles.description: The host's calling shape is the contract; a main that cannot read it fails on every walk.

heuristics.condition: a pipeline fails with a missing-field error whose column equals the input length
heuristics.action: suspect the envelope before the schema

heuristics.condition: a pipeline is not built yet
heuristics.action: give it the unwrap when it is built

decision_rules.name: Accept both shapes
decision_rules.condition: a pipeline main parses its input
decision_rules.outcome: treat the input as an envelope only when the top-level object holds both an object named data and a context, and unwrap it; flat input still works

decision_rules.name: Test both
decision_rules.condition: a pipeline main is added or changed
decision_rules.outcome: feed it the envelope and the flat form and check both parse

decision_rules.name: Diagnose the envelope first
decision_rules.condition: a pipeline reports a missing-field parse error
decision_rules.outcome: compare the error column with the length of the whole input before changing the schema
